groups.title: Tools in active development, each with its own site.
groups.lead: Released from signed tags. Every release updates its package here, and the card shows the version the tap installs.

groups.title: Still installable, no longer in active development.
groups.lead: Forks that added what upstream lacked at the time, a project template and an earlier service. Their packages stay at their last release.

items.name: maintainer
items.title: maintainer
items.tagline: See all of your open source. Move it every day.
items.summary: A local hub shows every checkout and every issue across your repositories in one place, and one CLI keeps the checkouts current and plans your next contribution.

items.name: indexit
items.title: indexit
items.summary: Describe Telegram users, bots and channels, export conversations as JSON Lines and keep the photos of a post in your notes, served by a local image service.

items.name: pulse
items.title: pulse
items.tagline: Your morning, with a hand on the pulse.
items.summary: The GitHub trends of trendshift.io and github.com as one calm morning paper that shows only what you have not seen. Keep what matters in one click.

items.name: sushi
items.title: Sushi
items.summary: A prompt composer for macOS: write or dictate, rewrite a selection with a model on your Mac, and send the prompt back to your coding agent.

items.name: service
items.title: go-service
items.tagline: Template for a typical service written in Go.
items.summary: The release of the template itself: a service and its client, built and published by the pipeline that a new service starts with.

items.name: sparkle
items.title: sparkle
items.tagline: A personal development framework and knowledge platform.
items.summary: The service of the Sparkle framework for personal knowledge management, with its sparkle command line.

items.name: godownloader
items.title: godownloader
items.tagline: Install scripts from a GoReleaser config.
items.summary: Reads a .goreleaser.yml and writes a shell script that downloads the right archive for the machine. A fork that adds Homebrew support.

items.name: goimports
items.title: goimports
items.summary: Adds missing imports, removes unused ones and formats the code as gofmt does. A fork with extended and simplified modes; its repository describes it as archived.

items.name: golangci-lint
items.title: golangci-lint
items.tagline: Fast linters runner for Go, with looppointer.
items.summary: A fork of golangci-lint that adds the looppointer linter; its repository describes it as archived. Shell completions come with it.
